title: Mole
paragraphs: “Motoyasu-kun, today you had Kou helping out, right? I need you to go assist Yuki-chan, who’s with Ren and the others.”
“Understood.”
There are always those who are quick to run when things go south. Besides, both Ren and Itsuki tend to be reluctant to kill when dealing with humans, so capturing them must be quite the struggle.
“It seems we had bad timing—the slave hunters had mostly withdrawn by the time we got there… Right now, Ren and the others are tracking down their remaining allies.”
“And what exactly is that creature?”

I took a closer look at the being that Father was trying to soothe. It was humanoid but had strong animalistic traits. A beastman, no doubt. Same classification as the panda beastman and that older sister’s sister.

However, this one was of a different species—it looked more like a mole person. There was still a shackle around its ankle, as if it had been restrained with an iron ball. The chain itself had been broken, but… It was clinging to Father, sobbing softly.
“Ah… yeah. We managed to save this kid somehow…”
This mole… I feel like I’ve seen it somewhere before.
“Hmm…”
“We were able to rescue this one, but according to the captured slave hunters, ‘We were unlucky to only catch one.’”
“Sniff…”
Father gently embraced the trembling mole and continued to comfort it. I recognize this scene. It’s the same way Father comforted Assistant last time.
“It’s okay now… You’re safe… No one will ever hurt you again.”
Sakura-chan and Rival were watching enviously.
“According to Eclair, this child is a beastman. Judging by what we saw… it must have been the entrance to a hidden village, one that looked no different from an abandoned mine.”
“Were there any survivors?”
“…Yeah.”
Father averted his gaze. It must not have been a pleasant sight.
“I knew Itsuki’s personality, so calming him down was tough. Right now, Ren and Eclair are doing their best to keep him from losing control.”
“Was it really that bad?”
“Yeah… There were signs that some had been tortured to death, and those who survived were enslaved once the captors got bored of their suffering. This kid’s parents… suffered a terrible fate.”
The mole flinched and trembled again.
“Humans… can be such cruel creatures.”
Father’s voice as he muttered that sounded utterly drained.
“Motoyasu-kun, even your methods are merciful in comparison. No child should ever have to witness something like that. Never.”
“Um… The Shield Hero didn’t show me, but… what exactly happened?”
So Assistant wasn’t aware of it?
“I think it’s better if Wyndia doesn’t know. If you absolutely must, then… maybe wait until you’re a little older?”

Understanding that something truly cruel had happened, Assistant quietly nodded. Sakura-chan remained subdued, sensing the sorrow in the air. Rival was the same. I leaned in and whispered to Father, asking what had happened. Apparently, he had just heard the details from the mole. Before being captured, the mole’s father had been killed by the slave hunters, the older blood-related sibling had been beaten to death, and the mother…
She had been pregnant. She was murdered in a horrifyingly brutal manner.
“The child was probably the last one to be taken away—the only one who managed to survive by sheer luck. I tried to save the mother too, but…”

Just as Father and the others arrived, one of the fleeing slave hunters landed a final blow, killing the mother right before their eyes. They managed to save the child, with Ren and Itsuki taking down the slave hunters, but it seemed that the child had only grown attached to Father, who had protected them.
“I’ve gone through loops to save Wyndia from misfortune, but this is the first time I’ve encountered this child’s suffering.”
He was subtly telling me to remember this. So, I made sure to commit it to memory. The demi-human purge in Melromarc needed to be brought to an end as soon as possible.
“And so, I want to take this child under my care. I was thinking of bringing them to Faubrey and making sure people understand just how horrific demi-human hunting really is. Would that be alright?”
“I would never object to something Father has decided.”
“…Thank you.”
“Hmm?”
Kou peered curiously at the mole Father was holding. He sniffed at them, seeming unsure whether he recognized them or not.
“And who exactly is this?” I asked. “I understand they’re a beastman, but…”
“Well, their name is quite long, but they go by Imiya-chan.”
When Father called their name, the tearful mole looked in my direction. If I remember correctly…
The Filolials in the first world mentioned this, didn’t they?
“I recognize this one.”
“Huh? You do?”
“They were in Father’s territory in the first world. Very skilled with their hands—I believe they made clothing for the enslaved people.”
“Oh… Well, I’m not going to make them do anything like that now.”
“By the way, the Filolials—”
“She looks kinda tasty,” Kou blurted out before I could finish.
T-this is bad. I really don’t want Kou to develop a trauma like last time…
“Eek!”
The terrified mole clung to Father, trembling violently. Father soothed them while shooting a half-lidded glare at Kou and me.
“Were they targeted all the time or something?”
“You understand well. This is the very mole everyone kept calling ‘delicious.’”
Father let out a deep sigh. Keel had also been a target for everyone, but given how strong she was, he was a tough opponent. Even the mole had struggled to keep up.
“Absolutely not. No exceptions.”
“I understand. I’m sure they all just wanted to give them a lick, nothing more.”
“The more I hear about Filolials, the more they sound like dangerous creatures…”
“Boo! Sakura wouldn’t do that!”
“Gaou?”
“I wouldn’t! I wouldn’t! I wouldn’t!”
The back-and-forth between Sakura-chan and Rival was rather heartwarming. Though of course, the one who was actually cute was Sakura-chan, while Rival was just the supporting character.
“For now, Imiya-chan, as long as you’re okay with it, I will protect you.”
“Uu…”
“Father just keeps gathering more and more people around him.”
Sakura-chan tilted her head as she said that.
“Yeah, it just keeps growing.”
“Sakura won’t lose!”
“I don’t think this is a competition… Anyway, we need to find any surviving members of Imiya-chan’s family or tribe.”
After saying that, Father turned toward me.
“In the first world, I probably found this child’s family or relatives, right?”
“Most likely. I recall them living in the village to some extent.”
“I see… Alright. Just like in the future you know, Motoyasu, I’ll find this child’s relatives.”

As Father spoke those words, the mole quietly stopped crying and looked up at him. I’ve seen that expression on Father’s face a few times before in past loops. And every time he wasn’t caught in a loop, he always managed to protect them. As expected of Father.

In the end, the slave hunters were too fast, and even Yuki-chan and Kou couldn’t catch up to them. Since Mole and Assistant were close in age, they quickly bonded and started spending time together at the camp. After eating Father’s cooking, Mole seemed to finally relax.
“Damn it! We couldn’t catch them!”

Ren was visibly frustrated. If the enhanced Sword Hero, Ren, couldn’t catch them, that was impressive in its own way. And not only that, he had Itsuki, the Bow Hero, with him. As someone who idolizes the fastest Filolials, I can’t help but wonder—just how fast do you have to be to escape from a group like that?
“The information we got from the captured slave hunter who held Imiya-san was minimal, too.”
“And when we tried to turn them in to the guild, the staff just tilted their heads in confusion!”
“They say common sense changes depending on location, but I really felt that firsthand.”
“It’s frustrating. After calling them out so publicly, I can’t do anything about it in this situation…”
“On that note, I have to say, Naofumi-san’s torture session was very satisfying. And the idea to take the matter to a guild backed by another country was genius.”
Ren and Itsuki were looking at Father with approval, discussing what happened after rescuing Mole. I wish I had been there to witness it.
“You really don’t want to make Naofumi angry. If that wrath ever turned toward us… I don’t even want to imagine what kind of hell we’d be in.”
“That’s right…”

“The look on his face when he whispered, ‘I’ll tie you up and feed you to Sakura and Gaelion,’ was chilling. Those guys probably thought no one could punish them… but hearing that wiped the smugness right off their faces.”
“The expression on the slave hunter’s face when Gaelion bit them was priceless.”
“And when they started begging for their lives, he just asked, ‘Did you ever spare the demi-humans who said the same thing to you?’”
“You know, this isn’t something to admire. Don’t use that as a reference, okay?”
“It’s clear—when you make Naofumi-san angry, he’s terrifying.”
Father gave Ren and Itsuki a troubled look as they spoke so proudly about what happened. But I understood their feelings. He could be kind at times, and harsh when needed. That’s who Father is.
